description: Bizuayeu's XSFP4 checkpoint (revision 88736f91) of Z.ai GLM-5.3-Flash, derived from NVIDIA GLM-5.3-Flash-FP4-Local: routed experts NVFP4 blocks fitted again from the BF16 weights with a smoothing folded in (block scale every 16 inputs, layers 3 to 44 stored losslessly compressed as csf_32x2_v1), served W4A16; everything else FP4-Local's tensors as stored. Served by TensorFold's native engine (1.2.7 at the creator's pin). Licence: NVIDIA Open Model Agreement (derivative of FP4-Local), commercially usable; upstream Z.ai model is MIT. Not gated.
